text:
toni: hi all, toni here (joined this week). trying to build the inference runtime from source on Windows WSL2 (Ubuntu 22.04) with an RTX 4080. followed devex guide but hit multiple errors. anyone available to sanity-check? :wave:

nate: welcome! can you paste the top cmake/make error and `nvcc --version` + `nvidia-smi`? small tip: WSL2 GPU can be quirky, dev-container or infra VM usually saves time.

toni: thanks. nvcc -> Cuda compilation tools, release 12.2, V12.2.89. nvidia-smi shows driver 535 + CUDA 12.2. build error snippet:

```
/opt/cuda/include/host_config.h:56:10: fatal error: cuda_runtime_api.h: No such file or directory
 #include <cuda_runtime_api.h>
          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lcuda
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
nvcc: error: unsupported GNU version! gcc versions later than 11 are not supported by this release.
```

devex: looks like a few things: 1) your include path points to /opt/cuda but toolkit is at /usr/local/cuda-12.2 (common leftover). 2) missing -lcuda means linker can't find libcuda.so (WSL exposes it under /usr/lib/wsl). 3) nvcc complaining about gcc means your host gcc is too new.

nate: run these quick checks:

```bash
ls -l /usr/local/cuda-12.2/include || ls -l /opt/cuda/include
echo $CUDA_HOME $LD_LIBRARY_PATH
which nvcc && nvcc --version
gcc --version
ls -l /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so*
```

then export correct vars if empty:

```bash
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.2
export PATH=$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CUDA_HOME/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
```

And if gcc > 11, install gcc-11/g++-11 and force cmake to use it:

```bash
sudo apt install gcc-11 g++-11
cmake .. -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-11 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-11 -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=$CUDA_HOME
```

infra: we recommend using our GPU dev container for WSL dev to avoid host toolchain issues: `ghcr.io/redwood-inference/dev-container:cuda-12.2`. If you prefer a full VM, ping infra and we'll spin up a gpu-dev VM (48h TTL).

toni: ran the checks: toolkit is at /usr/local/cuda-12.2, but /opt/cuda exists from an old install. libcuda is only at /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so -> /proc/driver/nvidia/000. gcc is 13 right now. i'll try the container first.

devex: action item: adding a WSL-specific note to the onboarding doc: recommend dev-container or VM, link to container image, and call out `gcc` compatibility with nvcc. filing PR now.

ci-bot: FYI CI matrix shows flakiness on WSL jobs; queued build rtx-wsl-12.2 to reproduce. https://ci.redwood.dev/rtx-wsl-12.2/9012

nate: if you still want to build on WSL host: remove /opt/cuda or point cmake to the right root, export CUDA_HOME, install gcc-11, run `sudo ldconfig` after installing toolkit so libcuda is discoverable. But container/VM is faster.

toni: used the dev-container image, build completed after forcing gcc-11 and setting CUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR. will open a quick PR to update the onboarding checklist too. thanks everyone! :tada:
